courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 多哈地鐵
related.transfer: 可遷移「通風散熱與設備溫升」與「互斥進路與真值驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；多哈地鐵的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" and "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Doha Metro must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦大型新建地鐵網分階段啟用與熱管理；多哈地鐵則以海灣自動地鐵熱濕環境與活動尖峰為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on large new metro network staged launch and thermal management; Doha Metro centres on gulf automated metro heat humidity and event peaks, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「通風散熱與設備溫升」與「通風散熱與設備溫升」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到多哈地鐵，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” and “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Doha Metro, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Communication delay and stale position", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 利雅德地鐵
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2024 年：利雅德地鐵第一批路線於十二月開始旅客服務；2025 年：利雅德地鐵橘線於一月加入營運服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以利雅德地鐵分階段投入服務為背景，建立多路線與轉乘節點同時驗收的教學案例。學徒要把高溫冷房、砂塵維護、列車循環和轉乘容量放在共同需求情境，並以各路線分別啟用的狀態表檢查服務邊界。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2024: The first Riyadh Metro lines began passenger service in December; 2025: Riyadh Metro Orange Line joined passenger operations in January. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the staged launch of Riyadh Metro to construct a teaching case involving several lines and interchange nodes under acceptance. Place cooling in extreme heat, dust maintenance, fleet circulation and transfer capacity within one demand scenario. Use a state table for separately opened lines to check the service boundary instead of assuming all parts of a new network become available at the same moment. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.text: 本課把「通風散熱與設備溫升」到「可用度與修復時間」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" through "Availability and repair time" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
